changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.8.0:

• ⚡ Instant & Reliable Wake Spotting: Restored acoustic phonetics (jervis, javis) for natural Indian-English voice recognition. Removed blocking RMS energy filter so normal speaking voice is detected immediately without delay.

• 🛡️ Anti-Flutter TV Noise Debouncer: Partial hypothesis requires 2 consecutive matching chunks (~80ms), completely blocking transient 1-frame noise flutters from TV commercials or ambient chatter.

• 🔒 Background Voice Guard: Unprovoked greetings in the background are disabled, and voice playback remains strictly muted in the background unless the turn has a confirmed wake word.
